blocked_reasons: Missing immutable model semantic adapter content corresponding exactly to SHA-256 a1492fcb0e8c44bc2f6bd496ef7cba205e757e591233da8cf5c724cfea302dc0. The bundle provides only this digest, not a path or document. Supply the hash-verified adapter source or a complete hash-verified operator-semantic specification covering all nine leaf stages.

Missing exact self-attention semantic facts needed to repair Attention.scala and RoPE.scala without inference: Qwen2 rotary dimension pairing/index order, position-id derivation for the 16-token leaf stream, causal-mask convention, GQA query-to-KV mapping at the semantic boundary, softmax axis, scaling placement, and the required FP16/FP32 cast points around Q/K/V projection, RoPE, score accumulation, softmax, context accumulation, and output projection.

Missing a hash-verified synthesizable numeric implementation contract or approved primitive source for the frozen IEEE operations required by the real-model checker: FP16/FP32 add and multiply, FP16 conversion with nearest-even rounding, FP32 accumulation, RMS reciprocal square root, SiLU sigmoid, softmax exponential/division, and RoPE sine/cosine. The supplied templates contain only signed-integer placeholder arithmetic, and no floating-point primitive/library implementation is present in the source bundle.

The generated/chisel/build.sbt content and dependency lock information were not supplied. Compile logs establish that the existing sources once compiled, but they do not establish whether a synthesizable floating-point library or specific Chisel/CIRCT APIs are available for a bounded semantic repair. Supply the exact current build.sbt and dependency versions or require a self-contained approved arithmetic implementation.

A loader/harness-only edit cannot be valid: it could route all declared words into the existing ports, but the existing templates either accept default/identity operation, ignore loaded norm weights, or consume FP encodings with integer arithmetic. Declaring dut_consumes_bound_weights=true under those conditions would not prove semantic consumption and would violate the binding contract.

Partial edits are forbidden by the task. Because complete attention, norm, linear, activation, elementwise, and residual semantics cannot be implemented from the supplied immutable facts, no manifest or harness files are emitted.
output.root_cause: The current run has no DUT weight-binding manifest or semantic leaf harnesses. More importantly, the selected Scala templates are not implementations of the declared IEEE floating-point Transformer operations: Linear initializes identity weights and performs signed-integer arithmetic on FP16 encodings; VectorNorm starts with weightsLoaded=true, does not use gamma, and only truncates FP32 words; Attention emits the collected V vector without QK, causal softmax, GQA context, or sequence storage; RoPE performs a parity-controlled integer swap/negate; Activation implements SiLU as integer ReLU; ElementwiseMul and ResidualAdd operate on IEEE encodings as integers; and Softmax is winner-take-all. Although semantic template repair is approved, the bundle supplies only model_semantic_adapter_sha256=a1492fcb0e8c44bc2f6bd496ef7cba205e757e591233da8cf5c724cfea302dc0 and not the corresponding adapter content. Consequently, exact stage equations, Qwen2 RoPE indexing/pairing and position handling, causal-mask conventions, GQA sequence behavior, and reference cast boundaries cannot be bound to the immutable reference. Inventing those details would violate the no-behavioral-substitute and immutable-reference rules.
output.summary: The supplied bundle proves that the current generated operators cannot serve as semantic DUTs, but it does not contain the immutable semantic specification needed to replace their placeholder arithmetic without guessing. A manifest-only or loader-only patch would falsely claim weight consumption and is therefore not provided.
